description: Admin. Users who call this MCP server with Basic auth. Passwords are hashed and never returned. The built-in admin cannot be replaced, updated, or deleted. Call get_schema with name server_users for every action's fields.

action.description: list: List usernames and scopes. | create: Create a user with scopes read, write, and/or admin. Needs username, password, scopes. | update: Change a password, scopes, or both. Omit a field to keep it. Needs username. | delete: Delete a user. Needs username.

scopes.description: admin includes write and read; write includes read

name: server_users
